title: Aksa Asks for Water Springs
description: Kaleb promised his daughter Aksa to whoever captured Kirjat-Sefer. Otniel, the son of Kenas and Kaleb's brother, took the city and received Aksa as his wife. When she arrived, she urged him to ask her father for a piece of land. She dismounted from her donkey, and Kaleb asked what she wanted. Aksa requested water springs in addition to the land in the Negev, and Kaleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
